preamble: The Middle Chinese voiced affricate of the 崇 initial (莊 group; Baxter dzr-, Zhengzhang [dʒ]) devoiced and became Mandarin [ʈʂ] in the oblique tones. The phonetic value of this initial is disputed: Zhengzhang Shangfang reconstructs the 莊 series as postalveolar [tʃ tʃʰ dʒ ʃ], which is the value used here, while Karlgren, Pulleyblank and Pan Wuyun reconstruct retroflex [ɖʐ].
sources: Zhengzhang Shangfang (2003). Shanggu Yinxi [Old Chinese Phonology]. Shanghai Jiaoyu Chubanshe.
Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. UBC Press. https://www.ubcpress.ca/middle-chinese
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press. ISBN 9780521296533
